brand_palette.rules: Warm Ivory (#F6F1E7) and Premium Light Ivory (#FBF8F2) alternating backgrounds. Deep Charcoal (#111111) for text, strong structural surfaces, and footer. Refined Gold (#B8894A) MUST be used STRICTLY as an ACCENT (badges, hover states, border highlights, key metric highlights). NEVER use full-screen gold or shiny metallic gloss.

font_families.mono: IBM Plex Mono / JetBrains Mono (for metrics, price tags, unit sizes, coordinates)

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-display font-medium text-charcoal leading-[1.1] tracking-tight
scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-display font-medium text-charcoal tracking-tight
scale.body_lg: text-base sm:text-lg font-sans font-normal text-charcoal-soft leading-relaxed
scale.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm font-sans tracking-wide uppercase text-charcoal-soft/70
scale.eyebrow: text-xs font-sans font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-gold

spacing_and_layout.section_padding: py-20 sm:py-28 lg:py-32 px-4 sm:px-8 lg:px-12 max-w-7xl mx-auto
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or rounded-md (max 8px) for crisp architectural feel; tab pills rounded-full

sections.name: Header & Sticky Navigation
sections.description: Sticky top bar with glassmorphic backdrop (backdrop-blur-xl bg-ivory-light/90 border-b border-charcoal/10 z-50), brand logo 'LOKAGER' in font-display with tagline 'WHERE PROPERTY MEETS TRUST', nav items [Buy, Rent, New Projects, Commercial, Land, Services, Mortgage, Sell Property, Login/Sign Up], and prominent CTA button 'LIST PROPERTY' in Deep Charcoal with gold border.

sections.name: Hero Section & Tabbed Search
sections.description: Architectural hero section. Headline: 'FIND PROPERTY YOU CAN TRUST.' Subtitle: 'India’s complete property lifecycle platform. Transparent pricing, title-verified listings, and deep locality intelligence.' Prominent tabbed search widget [BUY, RENT, NEW PROJECTS, COMMERCIAL, LAND] with fields: City/Locality/Project, Property Type dropdown, Budget range slider/selector, and primary CTA 'SEARCH PROPERTIES' in Deep Charcoal + Refined Gold hover.

sections.name: Trust Layer (4 Pillars)
sections.description: Heading: 'PROPERTY DECISIONS DESERVE MORE TRUST.' 4 Pillars: (1) Verified Legal Titles, (2) Zero-Spam Direct Connect, (3) Real Market Pricing History, (4) End-to-End Escrow & Advisory. Soft Ivory background, delicate 1px charcoal border cards with gold accent indicators.

sections.name: Huge Premium Ad/Video Showcase
sections.description: Cinematic 16:9 aspect ratio showcase container (~85% container width). Displays featured developer / architect showcase with image + HTML5 background video toggle, custom Play/Pause/Mute controls, Advertiser Name ('DLF Luxury Estates'), Headline ('The Camellias II - Golf Course Road'), CTA ('Explore Private Residences'), and subtle 'SPONSORED SHOWCASE' disclosure badge.

sections.name: Explore Property Category Cards
sections.description: 6 Large architectural category cards [Buy a Home, Rent a Home, New Projects, Commercial, Land & Plots, Mortgage] with hover zoom photography, item counts, starting price indications, and quick filter links.

sections.name: Featured Properties Grid
sections.description: Grid of premium PropertyCard items with badges ('Verified Title', 'Zero Brokerage'), high-res photos, location, BHK/sqft specs, price in Cr/Lakhs, and 'Schedule Private Tour' button.

sections.name: Featured New Projects
sections.description: ProjectCard grid featuring upcoming luxury townships and high-rises by top developers. Displays developer reputation score, RERA registration badge, completion date, and brochure download trigger.

sections.name: Locality Intelligence
sections.description: Heading: 'KNOW THE LOCATION BEFORE YOU CHOOSE THE PROPERTY.' Cards for top Indian hubs (e.g. Worli Mumbai, Indiranagar Bengaluru, Golf Course Road Gurugram, Jubilee Hills Hyderabad) with Livability Index, Price CAGR %, School/Airport proximity, and Noise/AQI scores.

sections.name: LOKAGER Property Intelligence (Flagship Tech)
sections.description: Heading: 'MORE THAN LISTINGS. BETTER PROPERTY DECISIONS.' Tech preview section featuring 4 COMING SOON AI capabilities: (1) AI Instant Title Risk Audit, (2) Fair Value Price Estimator, (3) Micro-Market Valuation Predictor, (4) Neighborhood Sentiment & Infrastructure Tracker. Charcoal deep background with subtle gold tech grids.

sections.name: LOKAGER Services (Ecosystem Extension)
sections.description: Heading: 'YOUR PROPERTY JOURNEY DOESN'T END AT THE PURCHASE.' Secondary section with COMING SOON services: Home Interior Architecture, Legal Title Verification, Property Management, Solar & Sustainable Upgrades.

sections.name: List/Sell Property Section
sections.description: Heading: 'HAVE A PROPERTY? BRING IT TO LOKAGER.' Segmented for Individual Owners, Certified Brokers, and Grade-A Developers. Key benefits: Direct buyer reach, verified buyer profiles, zero spam phone calls.

sections.name: Trust Statement
sections.description: Heading: 'TRUST ISN'T A BADGE. IT'S HOW THE PLATFORM IS BUILT.' Architectural quote layout highlighting platform integrity, data privacy, verified listings, and buyer protection guarantee.

sections.name: India → Global Vision
sections.description: Heading: 'ROOTED IN INDIA. BUILT FOR THE WORLD.' Subtle architectural coordinate grid language, highlighting expansion across Tier-1/Tier-2 Indian capitals to global NRI corridors (Dubai, Singapore, London, New York). NO cheap flags; uses elegant typographic coordinates and latitude/longitude graphics.

sections.name: National-Brand Footer
sections.description: Deep Charcoal background, crisp ivory typography, 4 columns [Discover, Company, Legal & RERA, Global Offices], Newsletter sign-up, RERA Compliance notice, Copyright © 2026 LOKAGER Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

micro_interactions_and_motion.framer_motion_defaults: Use easeOut or cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for smooth premium reveals. Avoid frantic animations.
micro_interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1.5) with border-gold/40 activation and shadow-xl.
micro_interactions_and_motion.button_interactions: Active states scale down slightly (active:scale-[0.98]). Gold buttons feature a subtle shimmer background transition.
micro_interactions_and_motion.accessibility: Full prefers-reduced-motion check integrated in index.css and Framer Motion variants.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 14 required homepage sections are implemented strictly in sequence with precise data-testid attributes on every interactive element. Maintain the warm ivory + deep charcoal palette with gold accents. Do NOT create generic AI-slop layout; prioritize architectural whitespace, high-contrast typography, and tactile UI controls.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow mobile-first responsive design, ensure all buttons and tab triggers have proper data-testid attributes, use Lucide React icons, and strictly avoid emojis in text/UI components.
